title: event-settings-tab-visibility.html
content: Each tab/section and feature of our listing, overview, and pre-checkout is configurable. On the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page, you can set each tab to “Always” or “Hide”. Some of the tabs can also be set to “Post-Registration”. If you leave a tab blank, the tab setting will default to "Hide." While the visibility can be adjusted, the order or placement of the tabs on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage cannot be changed. If you would like to configure other labels, check out our Data Dictionary / Translations , which allows you to override almost any text. Attendees Always Anyone can see the list of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who have registered for an {{variable.Object_Event}} on the Attendees tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Attendees}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The Attendees tab will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendFullName}} and company name (Contact {{variable.Field_Contact_AcctName}} ) will be visible. Post Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who have registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Attendees}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the Attendees tab, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one will see the Attendees tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Attendees}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Contact Us Before you can make the Contact Us tab visible, you must enter an email address in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click here for more information about the Contact Us feature. Always Anyone can see the Contact Us tab and the email address in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_ContactUs}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field and enter an email address. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The Contact Us tab will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage. Post-Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the Contact Us tab and the email address in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_ContactUs}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field and enter an email address. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the Contact Us tab, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the Contact Us tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_ContactUs}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Content Before you can make the Content tab visible, you must create an {{variable.Object_EventContent}} record and attach it to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click here for more information about the {{variable.Object_EventContent}} record. Always Anyone can see the Content tab on the Event webpage. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Content}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_EventContent}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_EventContent_ContentName}} (required) {{variable.Field_EventContent_URL}} (required) {{variable.Field_EventContent_Type}} {{variable.Field_EventContent_Description}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The Content tab will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage. NOTE: The Content tab will be hidden by default if no {{variable.Object_EventContent}} records are related to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Post-Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the Content tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Content}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_EventContent}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_EventContent_ContentName}} (required) {{variable.Field_EventContent_URL}} (required) {{variable.Field_EventContent_Type}} {{variable.Field_EventContent_Description}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. To see the Content tab, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the Content tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Content}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Custom Tabs Before you can make a Custom tab visible, you must create a {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} record from the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click here for more information about {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} . Always Anyone can see the Custom Tab on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomTabs}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_CustomContent_CustConten}} (required) {{variable.Field_CustomContent_Content}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The custom tab ( {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} ) will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. Hide No one can see the Custom tab ( {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} ) even though a {{variable.Object_CustomContent}} record is related to an {{variable.Object_Event}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustomTabs}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . FAQ From the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, create an Event FAQ record. Always Anyone can see the FAQ Tab on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Fields_ETETSettings_FAQ}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_EventFAQ}} s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Category}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_SortOrder}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Question}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Answer}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The FAQ tab will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. NOTE: Even if {{variable.Fields_ETETSettings_FAQ}} = “Always,” the FAQ tab won’t be visible on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage until you create {{variable.Object_EventFAQ}} records and relate them to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Post-Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the FAQ tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Fields_ETETSettings_FAQ}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_EventFAQ}} s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} . Complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Category}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_SortOrder}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Question}} {{variable.Field_EventFAQ_Answer}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the FAQ tab, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the FAQ tab. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Fields_ETETSettings_FAQ}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Sessions Before you can make the Sessions tab visible, you must create a {{variable.Object_Session}} record and attach it to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_Session}} s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} and follow these steps to create a new {{variable.Object_Session}} . Go back to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The Sessions tab will be located at the top of the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. NOTE: The Sessions tab will only be visible if the {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETSession_Status}} = “Active.” Post-Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the Sessions tab. Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Speakers}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Speakers}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_Speaker}} s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} and follow the steps here to create a new {{variable.Object_Speaker}} . Sponsors Before you can make the Sponsors tab visible, you must create a {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} record and attach it to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Sponsors}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} and create a new {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} . Go back to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the Sponsors tab, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the Sponsors tab. Tracks Before you can make the Tracks tab visible, you must create {{variable.Object_Track}} s and relate them to {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Click here for more information about creating {{variable.Object_Track}} s. Always Anyone can see the Tracks Tab on the Session selection page during checkout. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Tracks}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Follow the steps here to create a new {{variable.Object_Track}} and relate it to {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The Track options will be available on the Session selection page during checkout. Hide No one can see the Track options even if a {{variable.Object_Track}} record is related to an {{variable.Object_Event}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Tracks}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Venue Before you can make the venue information visible, you must enter it in the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Either select an {{variable.Object_Account}} record in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Venue}} field or fill in the following {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueName}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueStreet}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCity}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueStateProvin}} , {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCountry}} , and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenuePostalCode}} fields. Always Anyone can see the venue’s information on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}} to “Always.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Enter information in the venue fields and click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The venue’s information will be on the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s Overview tab. Post-Registration Only registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can see the venue's information. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Enter information in the venue fields. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the venue's information, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the venue information. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}} to “Hide.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . The WiFi information will be on the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s Overview tab. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WiFi}} to “Post-Registration.” Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the related {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Enter information in the WiFi fields. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . To see the WiFi information, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must go to their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} and click {{variable.Button_Done}} . Hide No one can see the WiFi information.
